lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Irregularly spaced, high-luminance circular clusters arranged in roughly horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region; highest density observed in the mid-lateral zone above the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersecting with horizontal spot rows, creating a loosely defined grid of anchor nodes across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Single prominent horizontal ridge with a sharp light-to-dark vertical transition, originating posterior to the head and extending towards the caudal region along the upper flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of discrete high-luminance spots scattered across the visible lateral surface of the first dorsal fin.
